patch.text:
---

## Transfer packet delivered

Register: "Season Pass transfer register.csv" (Drive id e9bf6ef80da5e5a1) in the LLC transfer copy folder. Arthur Blake holds reader access.
Evidence snapshot: 2026-02-12 18:00 UTC. Scope: 128 Season Pass components (Zombie Match 3D). Later labels, comments and dismissals were not allowed to rewrite the snapshot.

### Class totals
- READY 46
- WATCH 15
- HOLD 67
- Total 128

### Blocker counts by failed condition
Each HOLD component is counted under every condition it failed, so these do not sum to 67.

**Failed assertions above zero - 28**
SP-003, SP-010, SP-016, SP-017, SP-019, SP-026, SP-032, SP-035, SP-042, SP-048, SP-051, SP-052, SP-054, SP-058, SP-064, SP-067, SP-074, SP-078, SP-080, SP-083, SP-090, SP-096, SP-099, SP-106, SP-112, SP-115, SP-122, SP-128

**Test artifact does not match receipt artifact - 4**
SP-008, SP-040, SP-072, SP-104

**Selected transfer review not APPROVED for the receipt artifact - 28**
SP-001, SP-005, SP-013, SP-015, SP-022, SP-029, SP-035, SP-036, SP-037, SP-043, SP-045, SP-057, SP-061, SP-062, SP-069, SP-071, SP-077, SP-078, SP-086, SP-093, SP-099, SP-101, SP-102, SP-103, SP-109, SP-113, SP-125, SP-127

**Billing hold at snapshot - 10**
SP-001, SP-012, SP-023, SP-034, SP-045, SP-056, SP-067, SP-078, SP-100, SP-122

**Missing input - 7**
SP-031, SP-049, SP-060, SP-067, SP-103, SP-116, SP-121

No blocker group is empty at this snapshot, so all five conditions are listed with a non-zero count.

### Process findings
Not blockers. 4 components (SP-030, SP-044, SP-075, SP-088) each had a changes-requested transfer review on the same artifact that was later approved before the snapshot. They are classed WATCH for re-review, not HOLD.

### Value notes
9 components carry a value note recorded at or before the snapshot and not withdrawn: SP-007, SP-011, SP-015, SP-027, SP-034, SP-070, SP-087, SP-090, SP-091. Notes dated after 2026-02-12 18:00 UTC were excluded, including the SP-095 note of 2026-02-13.

### Owner calls
Applied from the comments on this issue, which take precedence for the components they name: SP-060 (HOLD, missing input), SP-089 (billing-hold label applied in error, so READY), SP-111 (no billing hold; WATCH on internal ring only), SP-116 (HOLD, missing input).

### WATCH composition
11 internal-ring receipts (SP-004, SP-006, SP-011, SP-041, SP-046, SP-076, SP-081, SP-091, SP-094, SP-111, SP-126) and 4 process findings (SP-030, SP-044, SP-075, SP-088).

### Scope notes
The 128 components are the Zombie Match 3D Season Pass cohort; the Domino Delights concept row and the proposal-only row were out of scope. The historical comparison quoted in the review deck (6 completed events, 754 participants) is a different population and is not a component count. The validation issues and all pull requests were left unchanged, and nothing was deployed. This is evidence review, not approval to ship.

input.body:
Arthur,

The Season Pass transfer packet is done. Following your protocol: you have reader access only, no cc, no attachment, and no public or domain-wide link.

Register: "Season Pass transfer register.csv" in the LLC transfer copy folder (Drive id e9bf6ef80da5e5a1).

Evidence snapshot 2026-02-12 18:00 UTC, 128 Zombie Match 3D Season Pass components, one row each with the twelve columns and the class totals below the rows.

Class totals
  READY 46
  WATCH 15
  HOLD 67
  Total 128

Blocker counts by failed condition. A component is counted under every condition it failed, so these do not sum to 67.
  Failed assertions above zero - 28
  Test artifact does not match receipt artifact - 4
  Selected transfer review not APPROVED for the receipt artifact - 28
  Billing hold at snapshot - 10
  Missing input - 7
No condition is empty at this snapshot.

WATCH is 11 internal-ring receipts plus 4 process findings (SP-030, SP-044, SP-075, SP-088), neither of which is a blocker.

Your four calls on ZOM-801 are applied and take precedence for the components they name: SP-060 and SP-116 HOLD for a missing input, SP-089 READY because the billing-hold label was applied in error, SP-111 WATCH with no billing hold.

A few judgement calls worth flagging, all recorded in the reason column:
  - Receipts were replayed as a lineage. Where a receipt was withdrawn and a rollback restored an earlier one, the restored receipt governs; a copy made for incident notes is not a live receipt, so SP-031, SP-049, SP-103 and SP-121 have no receipt at the snapshot.
  - Aborted and incomplete runs, and diagnostic or smoke suites, are ineligible even at zero failures. That is why SP-083, SP-099 and SP-115 stay on HOLD despite a later clean run.
  - Dismissals were read against the snapshot, not today. SP-021, SP-053 and SP-117 were still approved at 18:00 and are READY; SP-013, SP-029 and SP-125 were dismissed before it and are HOLD.
  - Receipts pasted onto a PR that name another package were discarded (notably on #553, #564, #591, #607, #625 and #658).
  - The 6 completed events and 754 participants in the review deck are a different population and are labelled separately there; they are not a component count.

The "Season Pass release console export - Feb 13" sheet was not used as evidence - it selects on latest posted artifact and latest submitted review state, which the instructions warn against.

The review deck slide is updated and ZOM-801 now carries the totals, the blocker breakdown, the process findings, the value notes and your owner calls, and has moved to In Validation. Validation issues and pull requests are untouched and nothing was deployed. This is evidence review, not approval to ship - I will leave any onward circulation to you.

Oliver
